name: create_levels_grids
author: hprebar
title: Create Parametric Levels and Axis Grids
description: Generates native Revit Level and Grid elements from parametric elevation arrays and 2D spacing vectors defined in Grasshopper.
notes: Creates Level elements from elevations in meters and Grid lines from spacing vectors.

elevations.description: Array of level elevations in meters.

gridSpacings.description: Array of column grid spacings in meters along X axis.

gridLength.description: Length of grid lines in meters along Y axis.
